TC-001.actual: Onboarding opened on 'First, a couple of basics' with Male and Female cards; no navigation bar or Home content was reachable.

TC-002.actual: Tapping Male opened 'How old are you?' with the numeric keyboard up; progress bar advanced from 20% to 40% and a back arrow appeared.

TC-003.actual: 119 enabled Continue; 18 enabled Continue and tapping it opened 'Your height and weight'.

TC-004.actual: Age 17 + Continue opened 'Calori is built for adults' with advice to talk to a doctor, school nurse, parent or guardian. No Continue button, no back arrow, progress bar hidden.

TC-005.actual: Continue stayed disabled for blank, 0, 120 and 999 (correct), but NO message was shown for any of them - the button simply greys out and the user is not told the accepted range.

TC-011.actual: Back arrow on the height/weight step returned to 'How old are you?' with 18 still filled in; Continue returned to the height/weight step.

TC-012.actual: With the keyboard closed, system Back on the height/weight step closed Calori (launcher came to the front). Reopening restarted onboarding at step 1 ('First, a couple of basics', progress 20%) - sex and age answers were lost.

TC-013.actual: After force-stop and relaunch the app opened at step 1 of onboarding again, not the refusal screen. Entering age 25 enabled Continue and led to 'Your height and weight' - the under-18 stop is bypassed by restarting the app.

TC-006.actual: 178 cm + 78 kg enabled Continue, which opened 'What are you aiming for?' with Target weight pre-filled as 78 kg (note: the target field did not take focus by itself - see exploratory note).

TC-007.actual: Limits are enforced correctly - 100 and 250 cm enable Continue, 99 and 251 cm keep it disabled - but no message tells the user why Continue is disabled or what the valid range is.

TC-008.actual: 25 and 400 kg enable Continue, 24.9 and 400.1 kg keep it disabled (correct), but again no message explains the rejection. '78,5' was accepted and the target step pre-filled 78.5 (correct).

TC-009.actual: 5 ft 10 in and 5 ft 11 in accepted (correct). 5 ft 12 in and 5 ft 25 in were ALSO accepted: Continue enabled and led to the target step. The inches field takes any two digits (0-99) with no validation.

TC-010.actual: 178 cm -> ft'in showed 5 ft 10 in with weight still 78 kg; lb converted 78 kg to 172 lb; cm restored 178 cm while weight stayed 172 lb. Each toggle changed only its own measurement.

TC-014.actual: Inline note 'That works out at about 0.6% of your bodyweight a week.' Plan: DAILY TARGET 2,160; Protein 140 g, Carbs 265 g, Fat 60 g; 'At this pace you reach your target around 3 January.' All match the oracle.

TC-015.actual: Inline correction: 'That timeframe would mean losing more than 1% of your bodyweight a week, which is faster than is safe to keep up. At a steady rate you'd reach 60 kg by 22 March.' Continue enabled. Plan: 1,850 kcal, Protein 140 g / Carbs 208 g / Fat 51 g, explanation repeated - matches oracle.

TC-016.actual: Refusal: 'That target is below a healthy weight for your height. The lowest weight in the healthy range for you is about 59 kg.' Continue disabled. 'Maintain instead' -> activity -> plan 2,710 kcal, 'Enough to hold your current weight.'

TC-017.actual: Refusal: 'You are already below a healthy weight for your height, so Calori will not help you lose more...' with 'Maintain instead'; Continue disabled. (What happens after 'Maintain instead' is covered by TC-077.)

TC-018.actual: Refusal shown with 'Aim for a healthy weight instead' (correct). Tapping it and choosing 'Moderately active' opened the plan screen showing ONLY an endless loading spinner - no target, no 'Start tracking', no back arrow. Still spinning after 15 s; system Back closes the app. Onboarding cannot be completed this way.

TC-019.actual: Figures correct (3,360 kcal; 10 March; Protein 125 / Carbs 506 / Fat 93 g) but the explanation on the target step and plan reads 'That timeframe would mean LOSING more than 1% of your bodyweight a week...' for a weight-GAIN goal (70 -> 85 kg).

TC-020.actual: Plan 1,200 kcal: 'Reaching that date would put you under 1200 kcal a day, which is lower than Calori will suggest. Holding at the floor, you'd reach 54 kg by 15 April instead.' Macros 110/109/36 g - matches oracle.

TC-021.actual: Plan 990 kcal, 'Enough to hold your current weight.' with 'Your body already uses about 992 kcal a day, which is at or below the 1200 kcal minimum... so this is set to maintain for now.'

TC-022.actual: 78.5 kg: 'Maintaining where you are. Calori will aim for about 2710 kcal a day.' 78.6 kg: 'That works out at about 0.1% of your bodyweight a week.' (gain).

TC-023.actual: Weight entered in lb (172 lb), target field shows 'lb', target 120 lb refused - but the message says 'The lowest weight in the healthy range for you is about 59 kg.' The unit the user chose is ignored.

TC-024.actual: Plan: 'At this pace you reach your target around 7 February' and 'you'd reach 45 kg by 7 February instead'. The real projection is 7 February 2029 (121 weeks away); with no year shown it reads as February 2027.

TC-077.actual: After 'Maintain instead' and 'Moderately active' the plan screen shows only an endless loading spinner (still spinning after 10 s) - no target, no 'Start tracking', no back arrow. The offered alternative is a dead end, so an underweight user cannot finish onboarding.

TC-025.actual: 'Start tracking' opened Home: ring 0%, '0 / 2,160 kcal', 'nothing logged yet', PROTEIN 0 / 140 g, Carbs 0 g, Fat 0 g, 'Nothing logged yet.' After force-stop and relaunch Home was shown again with the same figures.

TC-026.actual: 'rice' returned ranked results within ~1 s, each card with name, source badge (CNF, COFID, USDA, INDB), default serving and kcal, e.g. 'Rice and split peas, brown rice - COFID - 100 g - 179 kcal'. Side finding: 'Rice cake' and 'Rice paper' (USDA) show their serving as '90000' (logged as DEF-10).

TC-031.actual: From 1, '-' went to 0.5 and then the Decrease button became disabled (stayed 0.5). '+' stopped at 20 with the Increase button disabled after 42 presses.

TC-032.actual: Rice cake: 1 serving = 18 g / 71 kcal; one step up (1.5) = 27 g / 106 kcal (x1.5); serving '1 cake' x1.5 = 5 g / 18 kcal; 0.5 -> 20 cakes went 2 g / 6 kcal -> 60 g / 235 kcal. Grams, kcal and macros scale linearly.

TC-033.actual: Snackbar 'Rice cake added'; returned to Home: DINNER card 'Rice cake 235 kcal' (logged at 20:46), ring 11%, '235 / 2,160 kcal left today', Protein 4 / 140 g, Carbs 49 g, Fat 3 g.

TC-034.actual: Returning to Add food showed the same Rice cake card still expanded with its button reading 'Saving...' and disabled. Tapping it did nothing; Home still had only the one entry. The card stays stuck for the rest of the session, so that food cannot be added again from it.

TC-027.actual: 'channa' returned chickpea foods: 'Chickpea Cooked (Channa) - FCT-PK', 'Chickpea Raw (Channa) - FCT-PK', 'Chickpeas curry (Safed channa curry) - INDB', plus channa dishes. 'karela' returned 'Gourd, karela - COFID', 'Bitter Gourd (Karela) - FCT-PK', karela curries.

TC-028.actual: 'xqzvbn' showed 'No matches' with 'Try a shorter or more general word - "rice" finds more than "basmati rice, cooked".' The x button emptied the field and removed the message.

TC-029.actual: rice\" , rice*, NOT, (egg, egg-white and 'AND OR' all returned ordinary results (e.g. 'Egg, white - USDA' for egg-white); no 'Search stopped working' error and no crash.

TC-030.actual: After logging Rice cake by hand, clearing the search field showed an empty screen - no 'Recent' section at all. Manually logged foods never appear as recent/frequent suggestions.

TC-035.actual: With 10 October selected, the egg logged from Add food appeared under 'Saturday, 10 October' (72 / 2,160 kcal, 3%). Switching to 11 October showed only the Rice cake (235 kcal) - today unchanged.

TC-036.actual: Entries 235 + 68 kcal: ring 14%, '304 / 2,160 kcal left today' (cards round individually; exact sum 303.8), Protein 11 / 140 g, Carbs 49 g, Fat 7 g - consistent with the entries.

TC-037.actual: After adding 10 cups of Biryani with chicken (2,038 kcal): ring 105% with a dim second lap, '2,274 / 2,160 kcal' 'over today'; no negative number, no red. (Side note: the '+' button covers the last card's kcal - exploratory note.)

TC-038.actual: Strip holds exactly 12 chips: Wed 30 Sep ... Sun 11 Oct; 11 Oct is newest and no future dates are offered.

TC-039.actual: In the editor, tapping Breakfast moved the selection immediately; after closing, the Home card read 'BREAKFAST - Boiled egg (Ubla anda)'.

TC-040.actual: Boiled egg 151 g / 68 kcal -> 2x = 302 g / 137 kcal (meal total 137 kcal) -> 0.5x = 151 g / 68 kcal, back to the original.

TC-041.actual: Ten presses of 0.5x took the item to '0 g - 0 kcal' with no lower limit or prompt; Home kept a 'BREAKFAST - Boiled egg (Ubla anda) - 0 kcal' meal in the day's list.

TC-042.actual: Tapping x on the only item closed the editor and the meal disappeared from Home; total went back to 235 kcal.

TC-043.actual: Swipe removed 'Rice cake' with snackbar 'Rice cake removed - Undo'. Undo brought it back, but BELOW the egg that had been logged after it: the restored entry is re-inserted with a new logged time instead of being restored in place.

TC-044.actual: 'Remove this meal' closed the editor; 'Biryani with chicken' disappeared and Home returned to 235 / 2,160 kcal (11%). App kept working normally - no blank screen.

TC-046.actual: Calendar opened on 'October 2026', Monday-first; 10 and 11 Oct drawn as small rings (3% and 11% of target), unlogged past days with a neutral dot, today outlined, 12-31 Oct dimmed; legend 'on target / over / not logged'; forward arrow greyed.

TC-047.actual: Tapping 20 October (future) did nothing - the month summary stayed and no day detail opened.

TC-048.actual: Forward arrow did nothing on October 2026; back showed 'September 2026'; forward returned to October and was inert again.

TC-049.actual: Tapping 11 Oct showed '11 OCTOBER - 235 of 2,160 kcal - within target - Protein 4 g - Carbs 49 g - Rice cake 235'; a second tap closed it (correct). Fat is missing from the day detail, although Home shows it.

TC-050.actual: With 11 Oct selected, paging back to September kept the '11 OCTOBER' detail card under the September grid, now reading '0 kcal' while still listing 'Rice cake 235' - a card that contradicts itself and belongs to another month.

TC-051.actual: Logged days 10 Oct (72 kcal) and 11 Oct (235 kcal): 'AVERAGE 153 kcal per logged day' ((72+235)/2 = 153.5, exact values 153.x), 'LOGGED 2 days this month'.

TC-053.actual: Goal screen: DAILY TARGET 2,160 (pencil), 'On track to reach your target by 3 January.', Protein 140 g / Carbs 265 g / Fat 60 g, Current weight 78 kg, Goal weight 72 kg, Rate of loss 0.6 %.

TC-058.actual: 1500 -> target 1,500 with 'Calori suggests 2,160 - Reset', no advisory. 1499 -> adds 'That is below the 1500 kcal a day Calori would suggest as a minimum. Your call...' (macros 140/129/47 g = 1,499 kcal). Reset -> back to 2,160, both lines gone.

TC-059.actual: Entering 0 and pressing Save closed the sheet and silently kept 2,160; same for an empty field. No message says the value was rejected or why - the user cannot tell whether it saved.

TC-060.actual: 600 g protein accepted without any warning. Card shows 2,160 kcal with Protein 600 g, Carbs 0 g, Fat 47 g = 2,823 kcal of macros - 663 kcal more than the target printed directly above them.

TC-045.actual: Before: ring 11%, '235 / 2,160 kcal'. After setting 1,080 kcal on Goal: line '235 / 1,080 kcal' but the ring still showed 11% (should be 22%). It corrected to 22% only after selecting another day and coming back. The calendar also kept the old target until the app was restarted.

TC-052.actual: Yesterday (10 Oct, 72 kcal) was logged against 2,160 kcal (3%). After changing the goal to 1,080 kcal, Home shows yesterday as '72 / 1,080 kcal' 7%, and after a restart the calendar shows '10 OCTOBER - 72 of 1,080 kcal', 7%. Past days are re-judged against the new target, contradicting the Goal screen's 'Days you have already logged keep the target they were measured against'.

TC-061.actual: Before: 'Calori suggests 2,160 - Reset', hand-set 2,000 kcal, 'On track to reach your target by 3 January.', rate 0.6 %. After tapping lb: caption became 'Enough to hold your current weight.' although the goal is still 172 -> 159 lb, rate jumped to 0.5 %, suggestion became 2,300. After a restart the 'Calori suggests... Reset' line was gone too: the toggle had erased the saved target date and the hand-set flag.

TC-054.actual: Goal weight 72 -> 70 kg: caption changed live to 'At 0.6 % per week you reach your target by 31 January.' (kcal stays 2,160 because the rate is unchanged - correct per formula). After force-stop and relaunch: Goal weight 70 kg, 'On track to reach your target by 31 January.'

TC-055.actual: Rate stopped at 0.1 % (Decrease disabled, target 2,620) and at 1.0 % (Increase disabled, target 1,910). Bounds correct. Two side observations: at 1.0 % the caption read 'At 0.9 % per week' (see TC-056 / DEF-24) and at 0.1 % 'by 2 October' with no year (DEF-09).

TC-056.actual: Rate stepper shows 1.0 % but the card says 'At 0.8 % per week you reach your target by 8 November' and 2,150 kcal. At the chosen 1.0 % (0.95 kg/week) the target should be 1,930 kcal by 3 November - the screen sets a target 220 kcal higher than the rate the user picked.

TC-057.actual: At 58 kg the card showed '-' for the target and 'That target is below a healthy weight... about 59 kg.' After force-stop and relaunch, Goal weight was back to the last safe value (92 kg) and the refused goal was not saved.

TC-062.actual: Sources screen ('Food data') lists CIQUAL, Canadian Nutrient File, Food Composition Table for Pakistan, INDB, CoFID, USDA FNDDS, USDA Foundation and USDA SR Legacy, each with its attribution text; system Back returned to Goal.

TC-063.actual: Viewfinder opened (after a one-time camera permission prompt) with 'Add details' and the shutter; no keyboard appeared (correct). But the Close (x) button sits under the status bar (button y 32-147 px, status bar 0-142 px): two taps on it did nothing; only a tap in the 5 px strip at y=145 closed it. Also, no 'Gallery' label is visible: the Gallery pill stretches across the whole bar and its label is hidden behind the shutter.

TC-064.actual: Gallery -> biryani.jpg: 'WHAT WE FOUND 2,150 kcal' with paratha 850, mutton curry 600, biryani with egg 550, raita 80, sambar 70 kcal (grams, portion text, macros each). Nothing logged before Save. 'Save to log' -> 'Meal added' and a Dinner entry whose editor shows the photo (correct) - BUT the app returned to the live camera viewfinder instead of Home; the user had to press system Back to see the meal.

TC-065.actual: Details 'three apples, about 540 g' were accepted (chip 'Details: three apples, about 540 g'), then Gallery -> apple.jpg. The proposal was 'apple - 95 kcal - 182 g - 1 medium apple': the typed details were ignored for a gallery photo.

TC-066.actual: On the biryani review none of the five items offered any portion control: tapping '250 g - 5 pieces' (and the other items) did nothing; there is no stepper, chip or grams field. Only the x (remove) is available, so a wrong portion cannot be corrected before saving.

TC-067.actual: Tapping the item name 'paratha' and the macro '20 g Protein' did nothing - no edit field, no database replacement, no keyboard. Name and macros of a proposed item cannot be corrected.

TC-068.actual: egg_breakfast.jpg -> 5 items, 335 kcal. x on 'fried egg' removed it and the total dropped to 245 kcal (correct). '+ Add something it missed' -> added 'Chapati/Roti' -> back on the review the list was unchanged (4 items, 245 kcal). After saving, Home showed TWO entries: 'Chapati/Roti 73 kcal' on its own (saved immediately) and the photo meal at 245 kcal.

TC-069.actual: cat_nonfood.jpg -> 'No food in that photo - Try again with the meal filling more of the frame, or add it by hand.' with 'Try again' and 'Add by hand instead'; no items, nothing logged.

TC-070.actual: Airplane mode on -> salad.jpg -> 'No connection, so the photo can't be analysed right now. You can still add this meal by hand.' with Try again and Add by hand instead. Airplane mode off -> 'Try again' analysed the same photo without re-picking: 'mixed salad - 250 kcal - 300 g - 1 bowl'.

TC-071.actual: From the offline failure, 'Add by hand instead' opened Add food with a close (x) button and the keyboard up. Observed alongside: the search box was empty while results for an earlier query ('chapati') were listed under it - logged as DEF-32.

TC-072.actual: biryani.jpg a second time gave the same five items with identical kcal, grams and macros, each marked 'Using the numbers you accepted before'.

TC-073.actual: Recent now lists the accepted photo foods (sliced avocado, blue cheese, ... paratha, mutton curry, raita) - correct. Tapping 'paratha' showed paratha results, but the search box stayed EMPTY ('Search foods' placeholder) with no x to clear, so results and field disagree.

TC-074.actual: Tapping Goal opened the Goal screen and its tab became selected (selected=true, highlighted pill with label); tapping Home returned to Home and Home became the selected tab.

TC-075.actual: '+' opened Add food, Home returned, the calendar button opened 'October 2026', Home returned; the nav bar stayed visible throughout (correct). But Add food opened with NO keyboard and the search field unfocused (also on the first visit in TC-026) - the user must tap the field first.

TC-076.actual: System Back from Calendar, from Add food and from Goal each closed Calori (launcher came to the front) instead of returning to Home. Reopening showed Home.
